text:
marta: Heads up — noticing weird deltas in the cost dashboard when runtime does a late-bind to a quantized SKU. Per-request token counts show the unquantized model, but aggregate rollups show quantized savings, so some routes show negative cache credits.

kevin: Repro steps?

marta: Repro: send request with model_hint=redwood/gpt-large and routing policy=late_bind_prefer_low_cost. Runtime ends up routing to gpt-large-8q for capacity, but token_metering events have model_sku=gpt-large (unquantized). Looks like telemetry for tokens emitted before the bind event.

sahil: So an ordering issue — route_selection.v1 emitted after token_count. Our unit-cost calc currently reads model_sku in the token event.

olivia-bot: deploy-bot posted: rollout v3.4 to inference runtime at 12:03 UTC :shipit:

anya: Two fixes: 1) ensure token events reference final bound_sku (or binding_id) once available; 2) make dashboard attribution resilient to out-of-order events — join by request_id and prefer the latest bind.

kevin: Also cache savings are being recorded against the original model_hint, not the bound_sku, so tenants see credits on the wrong route.

marta: Example logs:
```json
{"request_id":"r123","phase":"token_emit","model_hint":"gpt-large","token_count":120}
{"request_id":"r123","phase":"route_bind","bound_sku":"gpt-large-8q","policy":"late_bind_prefer_low_cost"}
{"request_id":"r123","phase":"cache_hit","prefix_key":"p1","cache_saved_tokens":40}
```

sahil: We should add a request-scoped binding_id and attach it to all telemetry emitted after bind. Also plan a backfill job to fix the dashboard for the last 24h window.

kevin: UI idea: in the cost dashboard, add a "binding timeline" column — tiny pill like `hint → bound (quantized)` with hover showing exact token split and credits. That should reduce support noise.

anya: For quota enforcement: if quotas are defined per-model-sku we need to decide whether to charge hint or bound sku. I vote bound_sku since runtime capacity gets consumed there.

marta: Edge case: fallback to a larger model mid-stream after we've already emitted tokens — we need mid-request attribution split at token granularity.

sahil: We already emit per-token events with sequence offsets; we can replay attribution by offset. Add a new signal token_event.bound_sku when available. If missing, dashboard should mark those tokens as "pending" and reconcile later.

olivia-bot: :thumbsup: Logging a telemetry schema PR now. Who wants dashboard changes?

kevin: I'll own dashboard PR and mockups. Plan: telemetry schema first (Q1), dashboard UI + reconciliation job Q2.

anya: I'll own quota policy update and add unit tests for per-sku counting.

marta: I'll implement request-scoped binding_id. For late-bind flow we can emit provisional token events with provisional_sku flag and later emit a bind event that reconciles them.

deploy-bot: incident-bot: created ticket INF-742: "Cost attribution mismatch for late-bound routing" assigned to @marta,@kevin,@anya.

sahil: SQL snippet for reconciliation idea:
```sql
-- reconcile token cost using latest bound_sku per request
SELECT t.request_id, COALESCE(b.bound_sku, t.model_hint) as final_sku, SUM(t.token_count) as tokens
FROM token_events t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, max(ts) as ts, bound_sku FROM binding_events GROUP BY request_id, bound_sku) b
  ON t.request_id = b.request_id
WHERE t.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY t.request_id, final_sku;
```

marta: Also please include route_policy and capacity_tier in telemetry so we can explain why a bound_sku was chosen.

kevin: I'll add a small "reconciling" badge on per-route cost cards for windows we know have inconsistencies; tooltip explains it's pending a backfill.

anya: Let's sync tomorrow 11:00am. I'll schedule a quick 30m.

marta: Thanks — filing quick design notes in Figma and linking to INF-742"
